description: Spec §7.3: SpawnExplosion (effects only: no damage) spawns one BP_DFFxExplosion within 15 m of the blast in the same frame, and the GameMode keeps the scorch decal it spawned (MI_DF_Scorch, at the blast; the restart before cleared the earlier ones): 4 m across (DecalSize, a half-extent, = (200, 200, 200)) and fading out over 20 s (GetFadeDuration).
